user.title: Connect to the S-BUS gateway
user.description: The scan broadcasts on UDP port 6000 and takes the chosen number of seconds. Home Assistant must be on the same LAN subnet as the RSIP / Z-Audio gateway.

error.cannot_connect: Could not bind UDP port 6000 — is another S-BUS tool running?
error.no_devices: No devices answered the bus scan.

init.title: Rescan the bus
init.description: Scan the S-BUS again and add newly found modules. Existing devices are kept even if they miss this scan (replies are lossy). New modules appear as devices after an automatic reload.

abort.not_loaded: The integration is not loaded — fix the connection first.
